test_drop_names: test the DataFrame.drop method with named index and columns, inplace operation, and errors='ignore'
test_drop: test the DataFrame.drop method for removing rows and columns by label with non-unique columns
test_drop_api_equivalence: test that DataFrame.drop labels/axis API is equivalent to index/columns API
test_drop_level: test the DataFrame.drop method with level parameter on MultiIndex index and columns
test_drop_with_duplicate_columns: test the DataFrame.drop method when columns have duplicate names
